daniel.quote: The location is perfect for exploring the city, yet the room stayed wonderfully quiet at night. The bed was incredibly comfortable and the concierge helped us plan every day. A real gem in Menteng.

sofia.quote: From the welcome drink to the final morning coffee, everything felt thoughtful and personal. The garden view made breakfast feel like a mini holiday. I only wish I could have stayed longer.

lucas.quote: Clean lines, warm lighting and genuinely kind service. I slept better here than I have in weeks. The neighbourhood is walkable and full of great coffee. Already planning my next visit.

emily.quote: I stayed at this hotel for a week and everything exceeded my expectations. The staff were warm, the room was spotless, and the breakfast had so many delicious options. I'll definitely come back.

aisha.quote: The room was beautiful, but it was the little details that won me over: fresh flowers, a handwritten note and breakfast served exactly how I like it. I felt at home from the first hour.

yuki.quote: Every corner of the hotel feels calm and considered. The rain shower was superb and the bed was pure comfort. I appreciated how quietly attentive the team was. A perfect base for Jakarta.

marcus.quote: I booked the family suite for a work trip and ended up extending my stay. Fast Wi-Fi, a proper desk and staff who anticipate what you need. Easily my favourite hotel in Jakarta.

about.subtitle: A little story and information about us and our houses
about.title:
A calm corner
of Menteng
about.description: AureHotel is a boutique retreat tucked into the leafy streets of Menteng, Jakarta. Housed in a restored 1970s residence, the hotel pairs warm timber, natural stone and soft linen with quiet, considered service. Every corner is designed to slow the pace: a shaded courtyard, a small library, and rooms that open to the morning light. We believe a good stay is less about spectacle and more about the small things done well.
about.description2: Whether you are here for a week of work or a slow weekend away, our team is on hand from the first welcome drink to your final morning coffee. We can arrange airport transfers, private dining, laundry and local recommendations, and we are always happy to share the neighbourhood we call home.
